notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the 1.3 patch. This is the patch that will precede online multiplayer planned for 1.4. It features a variety of quality of life improvements and work under the hood to get ready for multiplayer.

[h1] Changes [/h1]

[list]
    [*]Controls
    New control scheme and updated tutorial.
    Grab with either the grip or trigger button.
    Teleport with the Pad-Up button.
    Rotate roomscale direction with the left and right pads.
    [*]Sound design has been rebuilt from the ground up to offer a much smoother experience.
    [*]UI has been rebuilt from the ground up to be much more response and easier to interact with.
    [*] The main menu has been reworked to have a friendlier atmoshphere.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Change Log v1.2[/h1]

[b]Tip For Curve[/b]: If you are having trouble getting good curve on the ball, make sure you are following throw the release with your wrist angled in the direction of the curve you desire. The effect is very noticable. We will be putting out a video tutorial soon to show how it can be done consistently.

[b]Change[/b] - Added options in the player settings when adding a new player to adjust how much curve and power modification is given to the ball. This setting is meant to stay on default, but if the player doesn't have enough space to get a good throw the power and curve can be adjusted to aid them.

[b]Change[/b] - Added additional help to the tutorial. If you are having difficulty pressing buttons, do the tutorial again by going to options/camera orientation and pressing tutorial. This should give you a better idea of how to press buttons.

[b]Change[/b] - Ambient noise has been added to both the space and basement levels. This can be disabled if desired by pressing the menu button when in a game.

[b]Fix[/b] - The ball will now not stop moving in the lane due to friction, the ball should always continue sliding.

[b]Fix[/b] - General tweaks to all the sounds to be more fluid.

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
This patch includes fixes and tweaks for better usability.

Change- Altered the play space to be better for 2M x 1.5M. This will allow          more room for all play spaces.

Change - Keyboard has been made larger to allow for easier input of bowlers.

Change - Added wording on the main menu to show that camera orientation can be changed in the options menu.

Change - Changed the slider UI element to be much more user friendly.

Fix - It is now impossible to start a bowling game without adding a bowler.
Fix - Sound will now properly initialize instead of defaulting to 0%.

notes.title: Release
notes.content: The game has finally made it to to release! It has been a lot of fun working on this game and virtual reality in general. We can't wait to continue adding features and additional content. If any issues are encountered don't hesitate to let us know and we will address them as quickly as possible. Be on the look out for multiplayer next!
